fix_subject: Fix OLD transition table recomputation of interdependent generated columns

labels.summary: The OLD transition alias recomputed generated columns in table order, so a generated column referencing a later-declared generated column failed with a spurious 'cannot be referenced before it is defined' error; the fix recursively inlines generated-column references down to physical columns before recomputation.
